description: Galas, a living oak gall as big as a head, one round woody ball filling the whole picture, green-brown bark-like skin with a few round holes, a crooked angry face of bark with glowing yellow eyes, two big black and yellow wasps crawling out of the holes, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the gall alone, no leaves, no branch, no ground, no background, the whole gall inside the picture
